data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Extending the proven optimal 12-input network (39 comparators) by inserting 5 additional comparators involving the 13th channel could yield a 44-comparator 13-input sorting network, beating the known 45-comparator best.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The optimal 12-input network's topology is too rigid, requiring at least 6 comparators to fully integrate the 13th channel, thus bounding extensions at 45.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The 13th input must be compared against at least 6 distinct elements to find its correct sorted position in the worst case, requiring at least 6 additional comparators.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"Inserting 5 comparators disrupts the 12-input network's sorting property, causing it to fail on some binary vectors.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"If the optimal 12-input network's partial order after 39 comparators leaves enough structural slack to absorb the 13th input with fewer than the 6 comparators required by a standard odd-even merge, a targeted insertion of 5 comparators might complete the sort for all 8192 binary vectors.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
